problemStatement.plain: Proves that the Taylor series of exp converges to exp(x) for all real x, with an explicit convergence rate. Using the Lagrange and Cauchy remainder forms, establishes exp(x) = sum x^n/n!, an error bound |e - S_n(1)| <= 3/n!, and the Cauchy remainder applied to exp.
